The following events took place in '''3627 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[third Galactic War]] continues between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="Onslaught" />
*The Sith Empire is defeated after [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|attacking]] the [[Meridian Complex]] in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Onslaught" />
*The planet of [[Odessen]] gains a seat in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] after the Eternal Alliance accepted the offer to join the Galactic Republic and reorganized their forces into [[Task Force Nova]].<ref name="Onslaught" />
